newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet dips with NYMEX, Gulf diffs gain.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet dips with NYMEX, Gulf diffs gain.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel prices slipped lower Tuesday, led by the sharp drop in the NYMEX heating oil futures, though U.S. Gulf (USG) differentials firmed slightly.
Market watchers said there was little reaction to President Clinton's move to delay a strike by American Airlines' pilots over the weekend by implementing a 60-day cooling-off period.
USG 54-grade barrels for delivery in the 6th cycle on the Colonial Pipeline were talked between 2.50 and 2.75 cents over the screen, up more than 0.50 cent from Friday.
However, USG 55-grade barrels for 6th cycle delivery were done between 3.00 and 3.25 cents over the print, near steady with Friday.
